title: Build in-house or outsource your software? Here's how to decide

points.heading: The real cost of building in-house
points.body: Hiring a mid-level developer in the Netherlands costs between €55,000 and €75,000 per year in gross salary.

points.heading: The real cost of outsourcing
points.body: A Dutch software studio typically charges €80–€130 per hour.

cta.headline: The full piece is on the site.
